chain.label: Left hydraulic system failure
chain.trigger: received an engine indication and crew alerting system message indicating a failure of the left hydraulic system shortly after takeoff

chain.label: Unable to extend landing gear
chain.trigger: the flight crew...was unable to lower the landing gear. After multiple attempts to extend the gear were unsuccessful

caused_by.evidence: engine indication and crew alerting system message indicating a failure of the left hydraulic system

chain.label: Emergency gear-up landing
chain.trigger: the crew declared an emergency and performed an emergency gear up landing

caused_by.evidence: After multiple attempts to extend the gear were unsuccessful, the crew declared an emergency and performed an emergency gear up landing

chain.label: Runway excursion and impact with localizer antennas
chain.trigger: it slid off the departure end of runway 20, impacted localizer antennas, and came to rest about 830 ft beyond the end of the runway

caused_by.evidence: During the emergency landing, the flight crew was unable to stop the airplane, and it slid off the departure end of runway 20

chain.label: L1 door deployment strap misrouted
chain.trigger: the deployment strap was incorrectly routed

chain.label: L1 door and slide failed to deploy
chain.trigger: The door rotated halfway open but would not open fully, and the slide did not deploy

caused_by.evidence: the deployment strap was incorrectly routed, which prevented the door from opening

chain.label: R1 bannis latch noncompliant with AD 86-09-09
chain.trigger: the R1 bannis latch on the accident airplane had only one link and lacked other required hardware

chain.label: R1 door lodged on slide pack
chain.trigger: the jumpseat occupant then attempted to open the right (R1) door, but it lodged on the slide pack

caused_by.evidence: the R1 bannis latch...had only one link and lacked other required hardware...which caused the slide pack to jam before the jumpseat occupant was eventually able to force the door to open

chain.label: Forced evacuation via R1 slide; all occupants uninjured
chain.trigger: The jumpseat occupant used force to open the R1 door, and the slide deployed normally...Both flight crewmembers and the jumpseat occupant were uninjured

caused_by.evidence: The door rotated halfway open but would not open fully, and the slide did not deploy
The jumpseat occupant used force to open the R1 door, and the slide deployed normally
